{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with the [[Ceremonial Trident]].}} {{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Lightscale Trident Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Lightscale Trident Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Lightscale Trident Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Lightscale Trident Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= {{List| * 1 [[Zora Spear]] * 1 [[Diamond]] * 5 [[Flint]] }} |value= |location= [[Zora's Domain]] |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 22 |durability= 70 |comp= [[Ceremonial Trident]] |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Lightscale Trident|Lightscale Tridents|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 22 |durability = 70 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lightscale Trident}} Lightscale Tridents are a variant of the [[Zora Spear]]. They belong to the [[Zora Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a group of [[Weapon]]s created by the [[Zora]]. {{Frameless|[[File:BotW Mipha Artwork.png|thumb|left|200px|alt= Artwork of Mipha holding her Lightscale Trident.|Mipha with a Lightscale Trident]]}} A Lightscale Trident was given to the Zora princess [[Mipha]] on the day she was born. Even though Mipha preferred to use her healing abilities, it is said that she was talented with this Spear as well. When she came of age, [[Seggin]] was the one who taught her to fight with her Trident. [[King Dorephan]] later had the story of the Lightscale Trident written on the ''[[History of the Zora, Part Four]]'', one of the [[Stone Monument]]s found throughout the [[Lanayru Great Spring]]. When Mipha did not return after the [[Great Calamity]], the people of [[Zora's Domain]] mourned her. They tried to send the Lightscale Trident down [[Zora River]] in an attempt to put her [[Spirit]] to rest. However, the Trident began to glow, and Mipha's voice was heard. She told the Zora that she was one with the Lightscale Trident, and they should forget their grief and focus on remembering her. As a result, the Zora celebrate the [[Champion Festival]] and honor the Lightscale Trident on the anniversary of the Great Calamity. However, if [[Link]] speaks with [[Trello]] while the [[Shrine Quest]] "[[The Ceremonial Song]]" is active, he will admit that the Champion Festival uses a replica of the Lightscale Trident instead of the real one. This replica, the [[Ceremonial Trident]], is nearly identical to the Lightscale Trident, but it is not as strong or durable. Link can obtain Mipha's Lightscale Trident after taming [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]] and saving Zora's Domain from flooding. King Dorephan will gift the Trident to him as a reward and symbol of their friendship. After the cutscene, Link can collect the Lightscale Trident from inside a [[Stone Chest]] in the [[Throne Room (Zora's Domain)|Throne Room]]. If the Lightscale Trident breaks, Dento will remake it if Link approaches him at the [[Hammerhead]]. To do so, he requires a [[Zora Spear]], a [[Diamond]], and five pieces of [[Flint]]. If the Lightscale Trident is not in Link's possession but still exists elsewhere, Dento will be aware of its presence and instead recommend that Link locates it. The Lightscale Trident is made of metal, and therefore it can conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if it is equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. It will also sink if it is dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but it can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. Finally, it will not burn if it is exposed to a [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_050" |Life = 70 |Power = 22 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 13 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 14 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 32 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 100 |BuyingPrice = 400 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Spear |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Lightscale Trident}} {{Frameless|[[File:TotK Sidon Artwork 2.png|thumb|right|200px|alt= Artwork of Sidon holding his Lightscale Trident.|Sidon with a Lightscale Trident]]}} Lightscale Tridents as they appear in {{BotW}} return in {{TotK}}. [[Dento]] describes them as formidable [[Weapon]]s that have been passed down by generations of [[Zora]]. Unlike other [[Weapon]]s, they have not [[Decayed Weapon|Decayed]] as a result of the [[Upheaval]]. [[Sidon]] now wields a Lightscale Trident, which he uses in battle. He wields his Trident throughout the [[Main Quest]] "[[Sidon of the Zora]]" as he and [[Link]] fight the [[Sludge Like]], explore [[Wellspring Island]], and clear the [[Water Temple]]. Sidon's [[Sage Avatar]] carries a projection of a Lightscale Trident, which stills counts as one for the [[Hyrule Compendium]] if a [[Picture]] is taken of it. During the [[War in the Depths of Hyrule]], Sidon will appear to fight beside Link if he has been awakened as a [[Sage]], and he will use his Lightscale Trident to fight both the [[Demon King's Army]] and [[Demon King Ganondorf]] himself. As part of the [[Side Quest]] "[[Glory of the Zora]]", Dento offers to make a Lightscale Trident for Link to thank him for saving [[Zora's Domain]] once again. He requires one [[Zora Spear]], three [[Diamond]]s, and five pieces of [[Flint]]. He is willing to accepted either a Decayed Zora Spear or an [[Intact Weapon|Intact]] [[Zora Spear✨]]. However, he cannot use a Spear that has a [[Material]] or [[Object]] [[Fuse]]d to it. Once Link brings him the necessary supplies, Dento will proceed to make him a Trident. Should Link ever break or lose his Lightscale Trident, Dento will be able to make him a new one. [[Qia]], the ancient [[Sage of Water]], can be seen utilizing a Lightscale Trident in flashbacks to the [[Era of Foundation]]'s [[Imprisoning War]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Lightscale Tridents make an appearance in {{AoC}}, where they are [[Weapon]]s used by [[Mipha]]. She can use one when she is chosen as a [[Warrior]] for [[Scenario]]s and [[Challenge]]s. Her Lightscale Trident also appears in [[Movie]]s in [[Narrations]]. For example, she wields her Trident when she protects [[Sidon]] from a [[Lynel]] in "[[Ray of Hope]]", when the [[Yiga]] ambush the part in "[[Assassination!]]", during a [[Monster]] attack in "[[A Song from the Past]]", and against [[Waterblight Ganon]] during "[[Rescue Across Time: Water and Fire]]". {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} In {{AoI}}, [[Qia]] wields a Lightscale Trident. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:TLoZ Mipha amiibo.png|The Mipha amiibo with the Lightscale Trident File:BotW Mipha's Statue.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Lightscale Trident, depicted in Mipha's Statue File:BotW Zora Spears Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of the Lightscale Trident (right) other Zora Gear File:TotK Sidon Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}Artwork of Sidon wielding a Lightscale Trident File:AoC Mipha Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Mipha with the Lightscale Trident File:AoC Mipha Model.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Mipha holding the Lightscale Trident File:AoC Lightscale Trident Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of the Lightscale Trident File:AoC Mipha Tapestry Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of Mipha holding the Lightscale Trident File:AoC Mipha Promotional Screenshot.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}A promotional screenshot of Mipha fighting a Moblin with the Lightscale Trident File:AoI Qia Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}Artwork of Qia wielding a Lightscale Trident ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ceremonial Trident * Weapon * Zora Gear }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Lightscale Trident}}

The Lightscale Trident
As told by King Dorephan

The queen and I were blessed with a daughter as lovely as a jewel. We named our princess...Mipha.

To celebrate her birth, the smithy Dento presented Mipha with a gift: a mighty spear called the Lightscale Trident.

Mipha grew into a bright girl and soon reached the age of receiving lessons from the royal family's order of knights.

The whole of the royal guard adored her, especially Sergeant Seggin, who loved her as if she were his own kin.

Under Seggin's instruction, Mipha honed her skills, and her radiance grew along with her skill with the Lightscale Trident.

As a Champion, Mipha made her people proud. However, once the Great Calamity stuck, she was never to return.

All of Zora's Domain fell into misery. The merest thought of the princess was enough to overcome anyone with tears.

As a way of offering her soul repose, they tried to send the Lightscale Trident drifting down the Zora River.

But when they did, the trident began to glow, and Mipha's voice rang loud and clear for all Zora to hear:

"The Lightscale Trident and I are one... Abandon your grief and know joy once again. Do not cry...just remember."

And so, keeping to her request, on the day of the Great Calamity...the day that Mipha passed from this world...

the Zora venerate the Lightscale Trident and remember their brave princess.

Such is the origin of the Champion Festival.|History of the Zora, Part Four|BotW}} {{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Red|ceremonial trident}} is used in a festival to honor Champion Mipha...
